sources.title: How to Register and Log In Using Single Sign‑On (SSO)
sources.snippet: Some employers offer Single Sign-On (SSO), which allows you to access your ThrivePass account using your existing company credentials. This provides a faster and more secure login experience without needing to manage a separate password.
